reviews.author: Derek Rivers
reviews.text: Bryan did an outstanding job fixing my heating and cooling system. From the moment he arrived, he was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough. He took the time to clearly explain what the issue was, walked me through the steps he was taking to resolve it, and made sure I understood everything along the way. What I appreciated most was how patient he was, he answered all of my questions without rushing and even discussed a helpful maintenance routine to keep everything running smoothly in the future. It’s rare to find someone who combines expertise with such great communication and care for the customer. I’m extremely satisfied with the service Bryan provided and would highly recommend Eveready Service Experts to anyone needing heating and cooling work. He truly went above and beyond.

reviews.author: Diane Hrubos
reviews.text: I don’t know how to say it except it was actually a nice visit. They were friendly and outgoing. They did their service. They explained what additional service we need and gave us an estimate. We had not had our A/C serviced in years and we expected there would be upkeep and repairs. They told us what services should be a priority. Although I can’t claim to understand everything they told us, they explained things slowly and completely including photos. I wish every service company was as pleasant as Service Experts.

reviews.author: Amari Harris
reviews.text: There are some practices about this business that I do not appreciate. Number 1 was zero transparency about the fees. They make it very easy to book an appointment for whenever but there was not an overt and explicit disclosure about service fees including an off hours fee. If that would have been disclosed I would have easily waited until the next day as it was not an emergency, but it feels like this was intentionally withheld in order to accumulate more fees. The fee in an of itself isn't a problem it's the lack of transparency that may eventually get this place sued. Further, whoever they sent out provided very unclear information and guidance about the issue. Not to mention that they struggled mightily to even find our home (not an issue with any other technicians, delivery people etc. I actually thought I was contracting with a different company when these people showed up, so I don't know if is there "off hours" crew or what, but the entire operation is questionable. Let me tell you , since they wont: Don't book a time on the weekend or after hours, or you will be charged additional fees. Also make sure, it's people that you intended to work with . If you sense any incompetence, just cancel the appointment.

reviews.author: Bryan Alves
reviews.text: I hired Everyready Service Experts to repair my water heater, and they sent a technician named Vasili who was absolutely outstanding at his job. His attention to detail and persistence made it possible to fix what I had assumed was an impossible issue. In addition to his expertise, he was incredibly kind and respectful, it was the best customer service experience I’ve ever had. Employees like him are truly one in a million.

Definitely would recommend everready, the only area of opportunity I would recommend for the company, not the individuals would be to have some type of square or payment device available.That way, it makes their job ten times easier and quicker.

reviews.text: Rafael is a professional gem. He not only replaced our thermostat today but he also patiently helped us to reset the wireless connection to our cell phone. Moreover, he checked the crawl space to ensure everything looked the way it should. Then, while he was finalizing an over all system check, Rafael replaced the air filter. He was the model of professionalism, knowledge, patience, and kindness. We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Charm C
reviews.text: I had this company for 18 years although every time their technicians tried to up sell something new but I held up tight. Understanding it’s a common practice for most businesses, I would not mind their noises. Lately I had bad experiences with a few jobs done by their plumbing department. First my ceiling had leaked drops of water, someone came out in the late Friday evening and said to call the office on Monday! When I called they said the earliest they could send someone was Tuesday. Seeing my small wet area became increasingly large , I called another plumbing company to fix the leaking pipe on the same day. Then due to the large area of the soaked ceiling, more expenses were guaranteed. I didn’t understand why this company did not even bother to fix my leaking pipe on the same day they came. Then there’s another job that required a plumber to reroute a water pipe in the basement. He left two drilled holes unpatched. No one noticed anything until the last weekend when the tropical storm Ophelia hit. The basement had water came in nonstop threatening to damage my basement wood floor. To our surprise the water came in through the tiny holes which are less than 4 mm in diameter. So when they called for routine maintenance, I asked that they fix my holes. Then the general manager Andy took over the phone call and told me since I already complained they would cancel me as a customer. I said I just finished scheduling maintenance with your customer service representative. He said he would cancel all the appointments. He said he would send people to fix the holes, but so far no one has called to fix the holes. Reading through the bad reviews from this site, I found every time there’s a bad review, the owner responded that the customer was wrong. Taking pride in your business is good but remember too much pride means you ignored the fact that your business was built by customers like us who paid you over and over through the years.

reviews.text: "Extremely frustrated with the lack of transparency and inflated costs. I paid a $100 diagnostic fee, but they refused to disclose the actual diagnosis or the specific parts that failed. Instead, they provided a vague estimate for a 'Level 2' warranty replacement. They also refused to credit the $100 visit fee toward the work. I found a local company that provided a clear diagnosis and completed the exact same warranty work for less than half their labor quote. I expected much better support for a system they originally installed.

reviews.author: Paul Soroka
reviews.text: Update: Johnnie Baker did a fantastic job getting our exterior drain cleared out. Being able to take advantage of the $99 drain cleaning special was a nice bonus. Prompt, courteous and skilled service as always. Update: Kaylee and Alex once again provided excellent service during a prepaid maintenance visit. Update: Brandon Bullard once again went above and beyond to provide excellent service when our copper dwv from 1968 decided to let go. Being a weekend emergency call he didn't have access to enough supplies to replace the entire 24' run of drain until the supply houses opened on Monday, but he was able to get a fix in place to allow us to use the kitchen sink until he was able to come back to complete the job. As promised by Brandon, scheduling called us first thing Monday morning to come back out a day or so later and finish the job. For a third time now Brandon has proven himself a skilled plumber providing excellent service. Update: Matthew Carter did a phenomenal job installing our new water heater. He was prompt, courteous and best of all, provided extremely high quality work while offering suggestions to extend the life of our equipment and answering my many questions. Can't say enough great things about his work Update: Kaylee was excellent at addressing all our questions and concerns during our most recent PM visit. She was prompt, courteous and provided excellent service. She even went above and beyond by identifying and correcting an annoying rattle caused by loose duct work that has been driving me crazy. Can't say enough good things about our preventive maintenance visit by Kaylee. Update: I can't leave multiple reviews so I'm editing to also recognize Joey C and his excellent service! We had what I thought was a leaking cast iron pipe dripping toilet water into the basement, which turned out to just be a poorly seated toilet with an incorrectly installed ring. Joey handled things quickly and professionally in a way that saved us time and expense. Can't thank him enough! Louis was prompt, courteous and excellent at explaining our home system to me and answering detailed questions I had. He also fixed a few things that had been overlooked on previous visits by other techs. Couldn't be happier with the service and would highly recommend Eveready and Louis to anyone needing reliable HVAC service

reviews.author: James Carpenter
reviews.text: Matthew was very kind, friendly, and helpful. His knowledge and skill set put us back in business. I commend his dedication and commitment to getting the job done right. Excellent work and I completely recommend Eveready Service Experts to anyone looking not just to get the job done but to get it done properly. Thanks Matthew!

reviews.author: Rebecca Jones
reviews.text: Jacob, was a very knowledgeable young man in a pleasure to have in my home. He was excited to have weekend work.

reviews.author: Kailynn Block
reviews.text: Griffin did an amazing job today!! Showed up earlier than expected which was a lovely surprise and completed his work in a good amount of time! Will definitely be using him again if we ever have any other issues!!

reviews.author: Phyllis Hudson
reviews.text: Griffin was very proficient and professional in serving me today. He explained everything in detail.

reviews.author: Vanessa Perry
reviews.text: Mitchell did a fantastic job. He was courteous, knowledgeable, and honest. He installed a new fixture in my closet and checked my other lights. I would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Sylvia Diersen
reviews.text: The service technician was very professional and worked diligently to make sure the system was in good order.

reviews.author: Deardra Gayle
reviews.text: Bryan was such a huge help. He did all that was possible to be done today. I am very satisfied. He went above 5 stars in my opinion!

reviews.author: Kimberly K. Kerr
reviews.text: Jacob did the routine maintenance on our units. He was very knowledgeable and thorough. He took the time to explain everything and show me before and after pictures. His friendly personality was an added bonus.

reviews.author: Aleria Hamm
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of working with Aymari Fields again. He was out to clean the vents in our new home. Extremely professional and went beyond in taking care of us. Everything went smoothly just like last time. We are still extremely happy with the service we received.

reviews.author: Jazmin
reviews.text: Griffin and Justin did a wonderful job servicing my hvac unit. They provided necessary recommendations to keep your home comfort running efficiently. Thank you both for the excellent service. Will definitely use them and this company again.

reviews.author: Felisha Trail
reviews.text: Joey and Bryan were wonderful! Very informative, patient, down to earth gentlemen. Despite the necessity to replace our AC unit, it was a pleasure to work with them.

reviews.author: Karen Bowens
reviews.text: I had terrific service this afternoon from Mike and Brian for HVAC unit, they were here within the hour. Unfortunately I live in a multi unit home and it was a plumbing issue not HVAC. They did take multiple pictures and wrote up a great report for me to turn in. I will need them back shortly for a tune up. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Richard Konner
reviews.text: Fantastic job! Mitchell and Jacob were superb! They made sure I understood what was happening and why. Very professional and dog friendly. Great team, thank you so much.

reviews.author: Paula Burton
reviews.text: Jacob was sent to service my unit. He did a very good job. I would recommend him to everyone. He was polite, knowledgeable business minded and a gentleman, there should be more like him.

reviews.author: Wendy Venson-Crump
reviews.text: Jacob, Eveready Service Tech. was very through in servicing my air condition unit and components indoor and on the exterior. His attention to details were excellent. He answered all questions and shared "before and after" pics oh what was serviced. I was very pleased with his performance today!

reviews.author: Donna Newcomb
reviews.text: Mike and Kaylee were great. They performed the needed service and explained everything to me. Will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Joy Harper
reviews.text: Harry, Jacob and Mitchell busting today from my maintenance review. They were professional, friendly and knowledgeable. They made recommendations to help to keepy system working!

reviews.author: ivan M.
reviews.text: Mitchell did an outstanding job in resolving my electrical issues. His patience and professionalism were exemplary. He explained the issues and provided solutions to avoid further issues. Job well done!

reviews.author: Richard Bunce
reviews.text: Kevon & Donovan were our service team. Installed a new heat pump. Both were very professional, courteous, & friendly. Helpful in explaining the operation and nuances. Appreciate their help and would recommend them strongly.

reviews.author: Michael Lepore
reviews.text: I received expertise service from Henry & Mitchel . They were very courteous & they arrived on the time as they informed me. I was very pleased when they covered their shoes upon entering my house. It was raining very heavy & they took proper precautions which pleased me very much. Thank you for their great service!!!!!

reviews.author: Alisha Parker
reviews.text: The electrician Mitchell came by to fix a couple of outlets. He was professional and knowledgeable. He made sure to clean up any leftover trash and he even brought shoe covers to protect our carpet. 10 out of 10!!

reviews.author: Brian Thomas
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. Very informative and supportive. Loved working with them! Matt and Josh are super Awesome!

reviews.author: Hannah Collett
reviews.text: Darren and Kayleigh did an outstanding job servicing our HVAC system! They were on time, friendly, and ensured that everything is operating smoothly. I highly recommend Ever Ready!

reviews.author: Jesse S. Bajaj
reviews.text: Very punctual and professional technicians. I initially used their services for for HVAC install through Costco and have been using them for regular maintenance and service calls and would refer them to any one. Great job guys! Thanks!

reviews.author: chris hockman
reviews.text: Jacob did a great job on servicing our ac unit and was very personable! Matthew did a great job with our water heater as well! Always a great group of guys!

reviews.author: Lois Schroeder
reviews.text: Jacob is wonderful. He very thorough and tells you what is going on by taken pictures. A very competent young man. I will ask for him every time I have my AC serviced.

reviews.author: Angenette Harris
reviews.text: Griffin and Darren did a fabulous job! Educated me about my system and gave me options. They were a second opinion and glad they were. Very genuine.
